body.value: 藩制一覽表第七
藩制一覧表（はんせいいちらんひょう）第七（だいしち）

Hansei Ichiran-hyō (Table of Domain Institutions), Fascicle 7 — the large opening title of the seventh fascicle, set in the rightmost (first-read) column. Fascicle 7 begins on this leaf: the facing page 108 is still fascicle 6 (Kitsuregawa), and Yūki is fascicle 7's first domain. Distinguished from the small running header of the same wording in the outer margin, which adds （結城）.
冊首標題藩制一覧表第七
○結城藩
結城藩（ゆうきはん）
Yūki Domain — the ○ marker opening Yūki's entry (and fascicle 7). It is the only marker on the leaf: everything to its left is Yūki's, and nothing to its right is data.
○結城藩
下總國結城郡（結城本郷外十二ヶ村）下野國芳賀郡（十ヶ村）都賀郡（三ヶ村）
下総国（しもうさのくに）結城郡（ゆうきぐん）〔結城本郷（ゆうきほんごう）ほか十二ヶ村〕、下野国（しもつけのくに）芳賀郡（はがぐん）〔十ヶ村〕・都賀郡（つがぐん）〔三ヶ村〕

Territory, part 1 — a double-column warichu note printed directly under the marker in the same column slot (read the right line first, then the left). Yūki district, Shimōsa province: Yūki honchō plus 12 villages. Haga district, Shimotsuke province: 10 villages; Tsuga district: 3 villages.
領地下總下野
常陸國（眞壁郡十二ヶ村、茨城郡一ヶ村）上總國（武射郡十五ヶ村、山邊郡二ヶ村）
常陸国（ひたちのくに）〔真壁郡（まかべぐん）十二ヶ村、茨城郡（いばらきぐん）一ヶ村〕、上総国（かずさのくに）〔武射郡（むしゃぐん）十五ヶ村、山辺郡（やまべぐん）二ヶ村〕

Territory, part 2 — the second warichu unit (right line first). Hitachi province: Makabe district, 12 villages; Ibaraki district, 1 village. Kazusa province: Musha district, 15 villages; Yamabe district, 2 villages. Taken with part 1, Yūki's holdings span four provinces and seven districts — Yūki honchō plus 55 villages (12+10+3+12+1+15+2) — a scattered, non-contiguous domain rather than a single block.
領地常陸上總
（原朱）庚午四月ノ調ニ據ル
（原朱（げんしゅ））庚午（かのえうま）四月（しがつ）の調（しらべ）に據（よ）る

"(Vermilion in the original) Based on the survey of the fourth month of the kanoe-uma year" — i.e. Meiji 3/4 = April–May 1870. A three-column red-ink note the 1928 editor set in the top margin, above the text block; it dates the whole Yūki entry below it. Note: the page prints 庚午四月, with no 年 — MASTER's transcription 庚午年四月ノ調ニ據ル inserts a character that is not on the leaf.
庚午四月ノ調ニ據ル
高貳萬六千三百六拾九石三斗貳升壹合五勺九才
高（たか）二万六千三百六十九石（こく）三斗（と）二升（しょう）一合（ごう）五勺（しゃく）九才（さい）
Assessed yield (kokudaka): 26,369.32159 koku. The sub-koku units run in strict descending order 石 > 斗 > 升 > 合 > 勺 > 才 with none skipped.
高
正租壹萬千三百七拾俵 但四斗入
正租（せいそ）一万千三百七十俵（ひょう）　但（ただ）し四斗入（よんとい）り
Regular land tax: 11,370 bales (tawara) of rice, with the subtext noting that each bale holds 4 to — so 4,548 koku, about 17% of the 26,369-koku assessed yield.
正租
永千六百八拾六貫百拾貳文
永（えい）千六百八十六貫（かん）百十二文（もん）
Ei-cash component of the regular tax: 1,686 kan 112 mon = 1,686.112 kan. Paired with the 11,370 bales of rice to its right, this is the cash half of Yūki's 正租.
永
（以下十行欄外朱書）「一本
（以下十行（いかじゅうぎょう）、欄外朱書（らんがいしゅしょ））「一本（いっぽん）〔ニ〕

The editor's flag plus the opening of the red-ink addendum, boxed together because the small-type note is squeezed into the gutter and its glyphs interleave with the main-type column beside it. The parenthetical is the 1928 editor's: "the following ten lines are vermilion writing in the margin [of the original manuscript]." 「一本 then opens the quotation — "in one [variant] copy" (the same formula prints elsewhere in this edition as 一本ニ曰 or 一本ニ云). The ten lines begin with 一本 itself and run past this leaf: 支配地總高 / 五ヶ年平均 / 一米… / 永…也 complete the five on this page, and the remaining five print on page 110 (lower_p067_right) — 産物税取調帳, 一金三十五兩也, 一金三步也, 〆金三十五兩三分也, and 一蠶種白木綿其外税無御坐候, where the closing 」 ends the quotation.
以下十行欄外朱書一本
支配地總高壹萬七千石
支配地総高（しはいちそうだか）一万七千石（こく）

Total assessed yield of the territory under Yūki's administration: 17,000 koku. This is red-ink marginal writing, not body text — the second of the ten lines flagged by 以下十行欄外朱書 (the first is 「一本 itself, which opens the quotation). The body's own 高 is the much larger gross figure of 26,369.32159 koku.
支配地總高
五ヶ年平均
五ヶ年平均（ごかねんへいきん）

"Five-year average" — a heading with no figure of its own, standing inside the red-ink addendum and governing the two columns to its left (rice 11,370 bales; ei-cash 1,686.112 kan). It marks those as five-year means, a qualification the body text never states for its identical 正租 and 永 figures.
五ヶ年平均
一米壹萬千三百七十俵 但一俵四斗入
一（ひとつ）、米（こめ）一万千三百七十俵（ひょう）　但（ただ）し一俵（いっぴょう）四斗入（よんとい）り

"Item: rice, 11,370 bales, each bale holding 4 to" (= 4,548 koku) — the five-year average from the red-ink addendum. It matches the body's 正租 to the bale. Note: MASTER transcribes 壹萬壹千三百七十俵; the page prints 壹萬千三百七十俵, with no second 壹 (both parse to 11,370).
五ヶ年平均一米
永千六百八十六貫百十二文也
永（えい）千六百八十六貫（かん）百十二文（もん）なり

Ei-cash: 1,686 kan 112 mon (= 1,686.112 kan), the five-year average closing the red-ink addendum with 也. It equals the body's 永 exactly; the addendum writes the numerals with the plain 十 where the body uses the formal 拾. Given a distinguishing prefix because MASTER's own labels for the body and addendum figures both reduce to 永.
